entries.rationale: Full delta is local reportTask-to-reportContent rename plus initial null. Read success replaces it before parsing; ENOENT optional early return and all other errors remain. No request scope, identity or export completeness rule changes.

Full delta converts string concatenations to equivalent templates and joined segments. capability and parameter iteration, escaping, route boundaries, disclaimer text, JSON formatting and --check/write destinations remain. Generated UI documentation is not provider acceptance.

Full delta extracts source-record normalization into an awaited helper. Empty, lexical out-of-root, realpath out-of-root, missing and non-file source checks run in the original order. Non-source lines and record count are preserved; no evidence record is silently omitted.

Full delta extracts options/selection/execution helpers, preserving process.execPath, fixed Stryker executable, shell:false, force flag, environment, unknown-shard failure and fail-fast outcomes. Schema campaign timeout increases from20 to40minutes; other campaigns stay20. The documented two-worker/full-suite schema workload justifies an outer deadline increase, with no score/per-mutant timeout/source-selection relaxation in this file. Prior c684 actual schema CI passed; current e97 campaign remains separate.

Full delta initializes timer to undefined and client to null, and turns an empty rejection callback into one returning undefined. Both initial client values fail the existing guard; success assigns the client before use. Close failure swallowing and bounded timeouts are unchanged. Reviewed offline only; no Telegram or external alert action was initiated.

Full delta changes immediate process.exit(2) to exitCode=2 and moves all network construction/delivery inside the explicit confirmation else branch. Missing confirmation still prevents any fetch. Confirmed branch retains URL validation, fixed alert endpoint, redirect:error, timeout, body cancellation and status checks. No actual alert was sent by this review.

Full delta extracts URL/retry helpers and renames JSON local. Retryable network/status classification, body cancellation, three-attempt bound, delay calculation and60second budget remain. Final retry now returns false then breaks to the same terminal error. Nonretryable status, invalid JSON and nonobject results still reject.

Full delta extracts registration/discovery/difference helpers without changing validation order, allowed naming, duplicate rejection, regular-file checks, missing/unregistered sets, sorted diagnostics or full-suite preflight. No test can be omitted merely by not registering it.

Full delta renames temporary child variable to spawned initialized null, binds child only after successful spawn and initializes failure null. Synchronous spawn failure still resolves1 and returns. Error/close ordering, timeout, subprocess arguments, isolation and coverage-flush barrier remain unchanged.

Full delta extracts existing identity, dates, gate, artifact and count conditions. Conditions split across requireEvidence calls still throw before dereferencing missing records. Exact revision/project/task scope, successful quality gate, hotspot completeness, byte/hash manifests and unique complete partitions remain mandatory. No gate acceptance broadening found.
